content:
Our school system doesn't teach you how to learn, it teaches you how to be taught. 
I've been thinking a lot about what we *should* teach our children. The thing I'm landing on most is teaching them "how to be happy". 
It's not as easy as it sounds. Happiness can be easy but sustainable happiness is hard. You can't discard the rules and always be happy. You still have to learn the systems and how to fit in, but you also learn the edges of the system and which parts are important to you.

Had another thought. 
If you don't get to choose what you believe then who is choosing for you? If it is you choosing, why don't you choose to believe what makes you happy? If it's not you, why did you give away that power and what are you doing to get it back?
